summary: ACM Research, Inc. filed an 8-K (Item 8.01) to report the closing of a registered direct offering of 2,884,615 shares of Class A common stock at $52.00 per share, generating net proceeds of approximately $149.85 million under an effective shelf registration statement. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation. The sale was consummated on May 15, 2026. No special-situation elements such as acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring are present. The filing is forward-looking in nature and discloses a completed offering for general corporate purposes.
